meta: Prepare employee interview questions with AI: asking about dating or hometowns is useless and unfair; ask about the job.

muc.title: Asking the wrong things
muc.text: Asking about dating or hometowns in an interview is both useless and unfair. Ask about the job.

muc.title: Ask with real situations
muc.text: Good questions use real shop situations, like asking how they'd handle a customer complaining the food is cold.

muc.title: Let them try a task
muc.text: For hands-on jobs, a fifteen-minute trial, like packing an order or making a drink, often shows more than a whole conversation.

muc.title: Ask everyone the same
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for five questions based on the criteria from the last part, then ask every candidate the same set to be fair.

muc.title: Three situational questions
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for three situational questions for a sales role, with signs of a good answer.

thu: Ask a chatbot for 3 situational questions for a sales role, with signs of a good answer.
